why: `actor/hall-usher` is staged by a `spawn-actor` beat and never unleashed, and it is not `vulnerable`: its body is `Invulnerable` for the whole delve, so no player can ever be credited with killing it and a bundle that pays for its kill can never fire. The engine refuses the declaration where it is written and names the three ways out — unleash it, mark it `vulnerable`, or remove the bundle. `fires` is left off because the usher never comes back, so this document demonstrates exactly one refusal. It declares no unit: `Actor.on_kill` is bound in the primary by `actor/hall-moth`, whose unleashed body a player can kill.
